interactive_queries.excluded_reason: The retained older profiler reported 0 MB engine heap and microsecond reference queries because it indexed a materially smaller semantic universe; it is not a valid alternating baseline.

covered_outcomes: specialized JRuby, generated, method-object, and reopened-definition proof fallback

rejected_designs.design: Store a TypeFact for every call and repeat full call inference at CallNode exit
rejected_designs.decision: Rejected and removed. It duplicated receiver/method work and polluted the global TypeStore.

rejected_designs.design: Pass-local hash cache for call outcomes
rejected_designs.decision: Rejected and removed. The corpus had too few identical keys for hashing to repay its cost.

accepted_design.summary: Retain compact file-owned call outcomes, derive deferred results from the navigation resolver's existing method result and MRO chain, reuse effective visibility, consult already-solved return evidence, and merge sorted outcomes linearly.
accepted_design.why: Covered CLI and LSP call cases receive the same exact proof or Unknown reason without another AST walk, another semantic store, or a second method-resolution policy. Hover permits a concrete specialized engine proof to supersede a compact candidate's provisional Unknown.
accepted_design.performance_assessment: The focused large-file end-to-end median remains within the fixed three-percent gate. Replace-and-resolve is 0.48 ms slower at the median; the focused edit and references p95 comparisons are 4.27% and 4.03% above the immediate predecessor artifact despite passing their fixed production budgets. Full no-regression acceptance therefore remains open.

limitations: The large-file evidence is one same-file semantic pass, and the query evidence is one focused project fixture. They do not replace warm workspace, allocation, worker-schedule, or fixed two-project peak-RSS measurements.
The scorecard remains diagnostic and score_eligible=false until the broader parity, real-project precision, and complete performance gates are met.
decision: Semantically accepted, performance acceptance still open. The compact resolver-owned design passes the complete bounded workspace suite and the focused large-file gate, but edit and references p95 comparisons remain above the three-percent comparison threshold.
